task: Stage 6: Art Harness / Art Loop (inventory, style contract, need detector, provider probe+adapter, manifest v2, QA, regen loop, practical shop-opening run)
issues: HIGH: Vision QA can reuse stale results and falsely pass: every invocation reads the shared /tmp/jc-artqa-reply.txt without deleting it first or requiring the current Codex process to succeed. A failed or concurrent invocation can therefore consume an earlier valid PASS, violating fail-closed QA.

repair_actions.actions: H1 provider-agnostic: art-loop now routes by req.strategy (reuse/compose/css/svg/generate/human_boundary); generation consults provider-status.json and auto-falls-back to a complete human-boundary package when no no-cost automatable provider is available. H2 QA fail-closed: art-qa computes the verdict itself from the 10 category scores (all must be numeric and >=70; critic verdict recorded but never trusted). H3: char-haru re-QA'd under the strict gate — correctly FAILED (48, wrong proportions/cropping/job legibility), request improved, regenerated through the loop (iter1 FAIL too-childish -> issues fed to prompt -> iter2 PASS); manifest has full scores. H4: need detector marks existing candidates as reuse_candidate requiring confirmation (never auto-resolution); fresh scan confirms the 3 shop needs are resolved by the new assets. MEDIUMs: atomic wx lockfile; link-qa hard-errors on >4MB and validates extensionless helper references (helper-def parsing); provider validates exit status, reply JSON, PNG/JPEG magic bytes and sips decodability before copying; legacy manifest entries now extra_cost_status=unknown with record-only note. Regression: build/lint/link-qa green.

H1: generator selection is now data-driven — adapter resolves --provider auto from a GENERATORS registry filtered by the REAL probe rows in provider-status.json (can_generate + safe_for_automation + subscription_included_confirmed); the loop passes 'auto' and records the provider the adapter reports; adding a provider = one registry entry + one probed status row, no loop changes. H2: QA is bidirectionally fail-closed — a critic FAIL verdict (MUST violation) fails the asset even when all numeric scores clear 70, and score gaps still fail regardless of critic PASS. MEDIUMs: register-existing writes extra_cost_status=unknown with a record-only cost note (mechanically reproducible, matches checked-in manifest) and skips assets already tracked by file hash (dedupe guard, duplicates removed); link-qa header now documents the intended severity split (duplicates warn by design because helper references are directory-scoped); need detector supports confirmed design-decision overrides citing source docs (need-overrides.json seeded with the two shop items from art-plan-v2), fresh needs show resolved_by_design=1.
